extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Plant parts and functions — roots (absorb water and minerals, anchor plant), stem (carries water up and food down), leaves (make food by photosynthesis using sunlight, water, CO2), flowers (make seeds and fruits after pollination), fruit (protects and disperses seeds). (2) Seed structure and kinds — a seed has 3 main parts: seed coat (outer protective layer), cotyledon (food store for baby plant), embryo (baby plant that will grow). Monocot seeds have 1 cotyledon (rice, wheat), dicot seeds have 2 cotyledons (bean, mango). (3) Seed germination — steps: seed absorbs water → seed coat breaks → root grows downward → shoot grows upward → first leaves appear. Seeds need water, warmth (suitable temperature), and air (oxygen) to germinate. (4) Plant types — herbs (soft green stem, short, e.g. mint, coriander, spinach), shrubs (many stems from base, medium height, e.g. rose, hibiscus, jasmine), trees (thick woody trunk, tall, e.g. mango, neem, banyan), climbers (weak stem, need support, e.g. pumpkin, pea, grape, money plant). Misconceptions: 'roots only hold the plant' (roots also absorb water and minerals), 'leaves just look pretty' (leaves make food by photosynthesis), 'seeds need sunlight to germinate' (seeds are underground and need water, warmth, and air — not sunlight until leaves appear), 'all plants are trees' (plants come in 4 types: herbs, shrubs, trees, climbers), 'cotyledon is the baby plant' (cotyledon is the food store, embryo is the baby plant). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function PlantsGame), NOT export default. Export interface PlantsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
